node.title: Re^2: How to split, join and trim leading / leading white space
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
On Perl v5.22 and higher, splitting on [doc://perlrebackslash#\b{},-\b,-\B{},-\B|\b{gcb}] (extended grapheme cluster boundary) might be better:

$ perl -CSD -le 'print map "-$_- ", split //, "u\x{0308}ber"'
-u- -̈- -b- -e- -r- 
$ perl -CSD -le 'print map "-$_- ", split /\b{gcb}/, "u\x{0308}ber"'
-ü- -b- -e- -r- 
$ perl -CSD -le 'print map "-$_- ", split //,
    "k\x{0301}u\x{032D}o\x{0304}\x{0301}n"'
-k- -́- -u- -̭- -o- -̄- -́- -n- 
$ perl -CSD -le 'print map "-$_- ", split /\b{gcb}/,
    "k\x{0301}u\x{032D}o\x{0304}\x{0301}n"'
-ḱ- -ṷ- -ṓ- -n-

(If the 2nd and 4th outputs above aren't displaying correctly, like in my browser, they should be "-ü- -b- -e- -r-" and "-ḱ- -ṷ- -ṓ- -n-".)

As an alternative in Perl v5.12 and above, [doc://perlrebackslash#Misc|\X] can be used. Update 2: E.g. split /\X\K(?=\X)/, ...

Update: Made last sentence more clear.
